allocation_semantics: Limits are checked before allocation. Conversion temporarily owns one []Pixel scratch frame and cpucompositor copies it into one immutable Surface, so working storage is exactly two RGBA16 frames apart from caller-owned input and fixed overhead.
alpha_expansion: Expand 8-bit alpha a to exact RGBA16 alpha a*257.
cancellation_semantics: Check context before allocation, once per output row, and immediately before and after final Surface construction. The final validated copy into the immutable Surface is atomic and no partial Surface is returned.
excluded_responsibilities: Media decode, YUV/RGB matrix and range conversion, chroma reconstruction, BT.709 transfer decoding, ICC profiles, HDR/tone mapping, resize/resampling, crop, rotation/SAR, text/vector rasterization, output transfer/YUV conversion, dithering, encoding and muxing are outside this profile.
input_alpha: Alpha is an independent linear 8-bit straight-alpha channel. RGB under alpha zero is accepted but becomes exact transparent black after premultiplication.
input_colorimetry: RGB uses BT.709/sRGB primaries, D65 white, the sRGB transfer function and full range. Chroma subsampling is none.
input_layout: Top-down, tightly packed RGBA8 bytes with exactly width*4 stride and straight alpha; no row padding or trailing bytes.
lut_generation: For encoded code c and v=c/255, evaluate the sRGB EOTF exactly: v/(1292/100) for c<=10, otherwise ((v+11/200)/(211/200))^(12/5). Multiply by 65535 and round once to nearest integer; an exact half chooses the even integer. The frozen LUT, not runtime pow, is normative.
lut_serialization: The 256 uint16 entries are serialized by encoded-code order as unsigned big-endian values with no header.
metadata_semantics: Every metadata token must exactly match this profile, including explicit 'absent' tokens for ICC and HDR metadata. Empty, omitted, inferred or platform-defaulted metadata is rejected.
premultiplication: For each LUT-decoded linear RGB channel q, evaluate q*a/255 and round once to nearest integer with exact half ties choosing even. Alpha zero produces 0,0,0,0.
quantization: No float, platform color API, intermediate RGB rounding beyond the frozen EOTF LUT, dithering, hidden clamp, or host-dependent approximation is permitted.
